proposals.title: Amir Dembo — Probability Theory: STAT310/MATH230 (15 April 2021)
proposals.use: Primary author further-study route for Brownian construction, continuous versions, continuous-time filtrations and martingale maximal inequalities. This chapter supplies its own restricted stochastic-calculus proofs and original problems.
proposals.verification: Opened actual 409-page author-hosted PDF. Inspected section 8.3 definition and Brownian construction route (printed pages 310-311), section 9.1 progressive measurability/stopping definitions (314-315), and section 9.2 martingale and maximal-inequality statements/proofs (319-322); inspected the process-construction route in 8.1. This does not audit the whole text or claim that it proves the general Ito formula. Brownian existence/usual augmentation remain explicitly invoked foundations in the chapter. Reuses the same stable author text as the existing dembo-probability-foundations record with a separately stated inspected scope.

proposals.title: MIT 6.265/15.070J — Lecture 15: Ito integral for simple processes (30 October 2013)
proposals.use: Official instructor course material for elementary integrals, isometry, martingale timing and bounded-continuous approximation. The manuscript constructs the integral on an explicit L2 closure and proves its full predictable density identification with indicator approximations.
proposals.verification: Opened official six-page PDF and inspected printed pages 1-5: deterministic partitions, simple-process isometry, martingale argument and three approximation steps. The source's regularization discussion uses an almost-sure Riemann-integrability premise; the manuscript does not present it as a proof for all merely adapted processes. No source exercise or numerical example is reproduced.

proposals.title: Martin Haugh — Introduction to Stochastic Calculus for Diffusions (Fall 2013)
proposals.use: Primary author finance-oriented method route for filtration, quadratic variation, elementary integration, scalar Ito transformations and GBM, sections 1-5. The chapter states its own convergence, regularity and integrability conditions rather than importing an unrestricted engineering heuristic.
proposals.verification: Opened actual 23-page Columbia PDF and inspected printed pages 1-8: definitions, elementary isometry, scalar formula and logarithmic diffusion examples. The source explicitly omits technical details; the chapter independently controls remainder/cross terms and directly verifies GBM before taking log. No reliance on the source's later martingale-representation, Girsanov or pricing sections, and no source numerical example or problem is copied.

scope_limits: Primary mathematical references, not evidence about empirical price dynamics or model calibration. Brownian foundational existence/usual augmentation are invoked rather than proved; the chapter proves predictable-L2 density, its stated narrower calculus and explicit SDE results.
